text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: "*pant, pant*! Whew!!"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah! Isn't this great?! Am I a 
genius or what?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The day before the Oka Sho. Fusaichi 
Pandora has shown remarkable growth. She 
seems ready to take on the race in peak 
condition!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Riiight~! I totally hit peak condition 
today♡ The first Tiara race is totally in 
the bag~♡

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
“—Alrighty, I'm gonna head out soon then, 
Trainer!”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today is the day of the Hanshin Umamusume 
Stakes. She insisted on watching the 
broadcast, so we adjusted our schedule. 
That's because—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
It's Kuu-chan-senpai's race, after all! 
She's had a rough streak lately, so of 
course I gotta cheer for her☆

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Well, see you tomorrow~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hoping Rhein Kraft's heroic performance 
would be an inspiration, the Oka Sho 
finally arrived! As for Fusaichi Pandora—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: She was running terribly late.

text_block_list.name: Racetrack Staff A
text_block_list.text:
How is Miss Pandora doing? Will she make 
it... in time for the paddock?
choice_data_list: Sorry, just a little bit more and—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: I'm soooo sorryyyy!!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
No way! Seriously?! I overslept! Sorry, 
sorry, I totally messed up—!!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Kuu-chan-senpai won yesterday, right? I 
pumped myself up big time before going to 
sleep, thinking, "I'm definitely, 
definitely gonna crush it too!"—so maybe 
that's why—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
I got crazy fired up even in my sleep! I 
dreamed I won the Oka Sho, and I woke up 
jumping out of bed!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
And then, I fell back asleep, and when I 
realized it, it was suuuper past noon... 
Sowwy.
choice_data_list: So that's what was going on...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Ngeh. Well... i-it'll work out somehow!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: ...U-Umm... You're mad... right?
choice_data_list: If that's the reason, I can't even be mad.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It wasn't that she stayed up late on 
purpose; rather, she seemed to have gotten 
overly pumped up on an unconscious level.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Seriously? ...Seriously?? For real 
for real??

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Eeeh...

text_block_list.name: Racetrack Staff A
text_block_list.text:
Fusaichi Pandora-san, please hurry up and 
change your clothes~!!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Ah, okay~! Sooorry!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Um... W-Well then, I'll be right back!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though she said, "It'll work out 
somehow"... I still can't shake this 
anxiety.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She went into this race with so much fire. 
If only she could run a race true to 
Fusaichi Pandora's style...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With that prayer in mind, the Oka Sho 
began.
